verses.gurmukhi: ਠਗ ਲੈ ਕੈ ਮੁਹਰੈ ਘਰ ਆਯੋ ॥
verses.translit_en: Thag lai kai muharai ghar aayo ||

pu.ss: ਠਗ ਮੋਹਰਾ ਲੈ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਆਇਆ,

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਕਾਜੀ ਕਛੁ ਨ੍ਯਾਇ ਨ ਪਾਯੋ ॥
verses.translit_en: tin kaajee kachh nayai na paayo ||

en.bdb: ‘The swindler took the coins to his house and, even, the Quazi could not acquiesce the hidden truth.

pu.ss: ਪਰ ਉਹ ਕਾਜ਼ੀ ਇਸ ਇਨਸਾਫ਼ (ਦੇ ਭੇਦ ਨੂੰ) ਨਾ ਸਮਝ ਸਕਿਆ।

en.bdb: ‘The swindler took the coins to his house and, even, the Quazi could not acquiesce the hidden truth.

pu.ss: (ਉਸ ਨੇ) ਬਨੀਏ ਨੂੰ (ਆਪਣੇ) ਘਰੋਂ ਕਢ ਦਿੱਤਾ

en.bdb: She banished the thief from the house as the swindler had turned falsehood into truth.(28)

pu.ss: ਅਤੇ ਝੂਠੇ ਠਗ ਨੂੰ ਸੱਚਾ ਸਿੱਧ ਕਰ ਦਿੱਤਾ ॥੨੮॥
